artboards.title: The switch, and the status defaults
Direction B — a card per quarter

annotations.text:
Roadmap mode inside the Map tab.
Same projects, same track hues, same tier and track filters as the graph — placed on the quarter their dates land in. Real data, 27 Aug 2026.
What it says out loud: everything lands in Q3, Q4 is two tails, Q1 2027 is empty, and four committed projects still carry no dates at all.

The status filter is the one control the two modes do NOT share. Graph opens on active alone (6 of 31); roadmap opens on every committed rung (11 of 31), or the future columns are empty by construction.
Not chosen. A card per quarter gives the goal a full line to read as a sentence, but you lose the side-by-side comparison — seeing how thin Q4 is against Q3 means scrolling. Kept for the record.
